messages:
PagerBot: INCIDENT ALERT: elevated 5xx and upstream timeouts observed on gateway cluster eu-west-1. 30s rolling spike, impact ~12% of requests. Pager triggered for on-call. Correlation sample: cID=7a9f4b2e-0d3c-11ec-8f2a-0242ac120004
Maria G.: I'm on it, grabbing traces. Any customer-facing reports yet?
PagerBot: Impact tags: routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat; customers: a few high-qps tenants in EU. Error signature: 502/504, upstream connection timeout, and occasional 5xx from runtime.
Josh L.: seeing large retry fanout to runtime in logs, multiple incoming retries within 200ms windows. Could be gateway retry amplification.
Katie (sre): Maria, can you paste the correlation ids you grabbed? I'll pull KV logs.
Maria G.: cID samples: 7a9f4b2e-0d3c-11ec-8f2a-0242ac120004, d23b9f12-3f5a-11ec-b7c9-0a58ac130002, f7e1a8b0-4a1b-11ec-9f00-0242ac150003
Josh L.: pulling proxy logs now. Snippet: ```
[2026-03-15T14:02:11Z] proxy[gateway]: upstream timeout for req=7a9f4b2e... backend=runtime-03 attempt=1
[2026-03-15T14:02:11Z] proxy[gateway]: retrying req=7a9f4b2e... (policy=3 attempts)
[2026-03-15T14:02:11Z] proxy[gateway]: upstream busy for req=d23b9f12... backend=runtime-07 attempt=2
```
Katie (sre): I'm seeing autothrottle kicking in on runtime hosts around the same time. CPU + queue depth spike.
EngRuntime: we have a partial GC + network flaps on runtime-07 in EU-POOL. Collecting JVM/kernel metrics now.
Maria G.: timeline so far (UTC): 14:01:40 first elevated 5xx, 14:02:00 spike and retry storms, 14:03:10 peak, 14:05:00 partial recovery observed in some cells.
OpsLead: Can we put a temporary mitigation? Options: 1) disable gateway retries for /v1/generate across EU, 2) route traffic to healthy region (fallback), 3) scale runtime pool.
Josh L.: I'm +1 on disabling retries first (low blast). The logs indicate retries are amplifying the load. We can re-enable after stabilization.
Katie (sre): I'm executing a quick policy change on the gateway rate-limit/retry: `PATCH /gateway/config` to set retries=0 for path /v1/generate for eu-west-1. Will monitor.
EngRuntime: request traces show KV cache miss storm too; prefix caching not hitting because sequence lengths varied. That increased backend compute.
Maria G.: pushing KV logs to share: https://kvlogs.internal/2189001234/summary (private) - contains aggregated traces and full request bodies for sample correlation ids.
Josh L.: After disabling retries, I'm already seeing fewer inflight requests to runtime-07. 14:06:20 backend queue depth dropping.
PagerBot: NOTE: customer-facing impact: API errors decreased from 12% -> 3% in 5 minutes after mitigation. Notified product incident channel.
Katie (sre): We should still gather full traces for RCA. Please capture: netstat, strace for one runtime-07 worker, and JVM thread dumps for period 14:00-14:08.
EngRuntime: collected thread dump + GC logs and uploaded to https://artifacts.internal/runtime/2189001234/ (link). Early look: concurrent mark-sweep pause at 14:02:05 on runtime-07 causing ~500ms stall, aligns with first amplification window.
Maria G.: hypothesis A: a GC pause on runtime-07 caused request latency which triggered client retry policy at the gateway, which amplified load and caused other backends to saturate -> cascading 5xx.
Josh L.: hypothesis B: a separate upstream microservice (tokenizer) had transient throttling, causing the runtime to wait and backlog; gateway retries then amplified. Need tokenizer logs for 14:01:30-14:03:30.
Katie (sre): I'm pulling egress and tokenizer service logs. If tokenizer is the root cause, we might see increased 429 or slow RPCs in its logs.
EngRuntime: pointing to tokenizer-05 logs: ```
[2026-03-15T14:01:59Z] tokenizer-05: request latency spike, avg=420ms -> 1.8s for a 10s window
[2026-03-15T14:02:02Z] tokenizer-05: rate limit backoff active for tenant=alpha-corp
```
Maria G.: good find. That supports hypothesis B. Both A and B could be contributing. GC pause + downstream slowdown equals amplification.
OpsLead: immediate next steps: 1) keep retries disabled for 10m window, 2) increase runtime pool in eu by +20% (auto-scale triggered), 3) notify affected tenants with ETA for full RCA.
Josh L.: scaling triggered: `POST /infra/autoscale` pool=eu-runtime count=+20% (started).
Katie (sre): I'm also adding a short-term routing rule: route heavy tenants to eu-backup if latency > 800ms. Testing rules now.
PagerBot: ACTIONS LOGGED: retries_disabled, autoscale_started, routing_rule_applied. PagerBot will create incident ticket INC-218900 for follow-ups.
Maria G.: collecting follow-up artifacts for RCA: - gateway proxy logs - runtime thread dumps - tokenizer service logs - KV cache metrics - request sampling CSV (attached in artifacts link)
EngRuntime: preliminary mitigation conclusion: disabling retries removed amplification vector, autoscale bought capacity, and routing offloaded a few tenants. Need deeper analysis of tokenizer rate-limiting and GC triggers.
Josh L.: for RCA doc: capture exact retry policy (3 retries, backoff 100ms), list of affected runtime hosts, and timeline with correlation ids. I'll start the timeline draft in the incident doc.
Katie (sre): tagging SRE rotations to add runbook steps: consider circuit-breaker at gateway for downstream services that exceed latency threshold.
OpsLead: Customer impact note: At peak ~12% error rate for ~4m window for a handful of tenants. No data exfiltration. SLA hit risk for two enterprise customers — notifying customer success.
Maria G.: I'm handing off to Josh to own the RCA write-up. @Josh L. you have the artifacts and the timeline. I'll remain on backup.
Josh L.: taking RCA ownership. I'll loop in tokenizer owners and EngRuntime for deeper root cause work. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
PagerBot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations stable, monitors normalizing. Closing page; follow-up RCA ticket INC-218900 assigned to Josh L.
